metadata.description: Claude Code mod: a pixel-art pet above the prompt input that changes with the session state, plus a browser-based editor for redrawing it.

plugins.name: dotpet
plugins.description: Shows a pixel-art pet above the prompt input. The picture changes with the session state (idle, working, done, sleeping), so you can see whether Claude is still working without reading the transcript. /dotpet shows or hides it; the art can be redrawn in a browser editor.
